# اُسْتُحْيُوا (ustuḥyū) /us.tuħ.juː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# اِسْتَحْيُوا (istaḥyū) /is.taħ.juː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
